race.comment: The speedster ROUGH CAUSE (6) ran subsequent winner Automne Tree to 0.8 lengths at Doomben two back then was just over a length away from Navy Pilot subsequently. Big drop in grade today and with blinkers on for the first time he is capable of running these rivals off their legs. BUCKEYE (5) is a new acquisition for the Munce camp and is back after a 20-week spell. Trialling in great style. Expect the NSW form from last prep to measure up favourably. SHE OURS (8) hasn't won for over two years but was brave in defeat at her latest appearance over this distance at Eagle Farm. Nice each-way option. LEBANESE (11) has drawn off the track which makes her task difficult, but the latest effort at Beaudesert had merit so don't write her off.
